Package ca.bcit.realstate

package ca.bcit.realstate
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    Address
    Represents an address with a unit number, street number, street name, postal code, and city.
    AddressReader
    The AddressReader class is used to read address data from a file and convert it into a list of Address objects.
    Agency
    Represents a real estate agency that manages a collection of properties.
    Assignment2
    Represents an Assignment2 object which is a driver class for the real state application.
    Commercial
    Represents a commercial property with specific features such as a loading dock and highway access.
    Property
    Represents a property with details such as price, address, number of bedrooms, swimming pool availability, type, and property ID.
    PropertyReader
    The PropertyReader class is responsible for reading property data from a file and returning it as a list of strings.
    Residence
    Represents a residential property with additional attributes such as the number of bedrooms, swimming pool availability, and strata status.
    Retail
    Represents a retail property with specific attributes such as square footage and customer parking availability.
